_about: Ground truth for scripts/eval/visual_eval.py, written by viewing each stored frame of the 74-minute Axia video (dev ingestion of 2026-09-15). Keyed by frame timestamp (seconds, matched within 1 s). 'legible' = strings a reader can make out at frame resolution; 'legible_numbers' = numbers that are readable on screen (other numbers stated as visible and found in the transcript are speech copies). 'stored_verdict' labels the description stored by the pre-fix pipeline: anchored | paraphrase | anchored_with_illegible_detail. 'relevant' = false means the frame shows nothing the speech refers to and should produce no description.
